harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#534; supersedes the 5343532c pilot, run 44838098884,
whose draft trace format it verified). One arm, shipped harness/borg.txt (sha256 19e65a96a5d9...752e), the borg-rs core,
errand none, /stopscared off, no overrides; classes-18 at 100,000 turns (18 games). Zero deaths is acceptable.
Gate: one binary; every cell accounted for with its terminal outcome (death, turn_cap or borg_stopped); full
trace-core.jsonl and summary.json retained for all 18 cells, survivors included, each with seed, race and class; every
traced think uses core-trace@3 and carries death_risk with the F1-F3 scores, the F4 fit features and stop_eligible
(checked cell by cell from the retained raw traces); missing or failed cells reported explicitly.
Report: the workflow and artifact links; the number of distinct death-bearing starts in the fixed training and holdout
splits (the split of tools/calibrate-death-risk.py at this commit), so the source session can judge F1-F4; natural
deaths kept as ordinary evidence. No tier advances under this pilot. Next, in order after the gate: classes-1800-small
(starts 1-90), then classes-1800-medium (starts 91-360, the approved 270).
